text:
Run Jev's evidence labeling without a person: derive class labels automatically (the work of `athena score-jev --derive`) as part of Hestia's sweep or at drain start, whichever already runs on a cadence, and make recurrence-after-prevention labels stable so a rerun writes nothing new when the evidence has not changed (today the basis carries a job count that changes as jobs close, so reruns append fresh copies). The first manual run on 2026-10-26 wrote 59 labels, all on introspections without a Jev answer, so Jev is not yet scorable; the scored set grows only if derivation keeps running.
Acceptance:
- A test shows the sweep (or drain start) derives labels for an introspection with new evidence and writes nothing on a second run with unchanged evidence, including a recurrence-after-prevention case.
- athena status shows the scored-set size and when labels were last derived.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs, crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, CHANGELOG.md
